fleet.hint: Tap a machine for details, or tap Refresh.
fleet.title: 🖥 Fleet overview
hello.fleet: Fleet mode is on. Tap Overview first.
help.body: 🤖 Fleet monitor Tap the buttons under this message. You don't need to type node names. /all overview, /nodes list, tap a machine for details. Lookup (commands still work) /go name one node /cpu /mem /disk /today /traffic /net /xray /uptime Add a name or all, e.g. /cpu all NIC occupancy (current throughput, no generated traffic) /net sg ~3s sample /net all Public speed test (download/upload via Cloudflare) /bw sg ~3s each way /bw sg 8 1–15s /bw all Coverage (typed, to avoid mis-taps) /add hk cap=2T reset=27 /cap hk 500G /off hk hide for now /on hk /kick hk remove; needs /add to return Caps: 500G / 1T / 2T / unlimited. The daily summary still sends automatically. Optional services (hidden unless configured) /svc hk xray 443,2053 /svc hk nginx 80,443 /svc hk xray off The node probes those TCP ports locally. The name is yours to choose. Tap 「中文」 or 「English」 to switch language. If a monthly cap and a reset instant in the host timezone are set, usage alerts at 80% and public traffic is cut at 90% until reset.
